findings.title: Mountains as vertical joints in a three-part spatial arrangement
findings.claim: The focus's concrete mountain masses, described as set upright, can be read with the raised sky and surfaced earth as the vertical joints that make the three-part spatial arrangement legible.
findings.mechanism: The focus noun supplies a large solid landform and the focus passive supplies upright emplacement; the independent sky and earth observations above and below let those two focus carriers meet as an intervening structural relation, while wider mountain-order connections corroborate the arrangement.
findings.reader_payoff: The mountains become more than an item placed between two observations: their position explains how the upper and lower planes are held together in one inspectable scene.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains the question of how the mountains were set. The structural mediation is an inference from the supplied sequence and connections, not a claim about a literal engineering process; connection targets lack supplied target morphology.

epistemic.reason: A trusted cross-run finding is independently echoed by legacy reader walks and an exact HFT context trace, but the joint or mediation relation is still an authorial inference.

findings.containment: The ordinary mountain and emplacement reading remains available. epistemic.reason: A trusted cross-run claim and a legacy wide-walk activation agree on a bounded resistance mechanism, while the geological function is inferred and is checked against supplied contrary dissolution evidence.

epistemic.reason: The trusted source marks the unbounded authority transfer as reject, while the independent wide walk supplies the bounded carrier-trigger relation and the exact later authority boundary.

findings.title: One emplacement word across purposeful and exhausting settings
findings.claim: The focus verb's upright-emplacement facet and its fatigue facet meet the exact 88:3 recurrence, so the word holds a contextual contrast between a firmly set mountain and humans caught in exhausting strain.
findings.mechanism: The same registered focus-root inventory appears in the focus emplacement and in 88:3's explicit fatigue form; the direct same-surah connection turns that recurrence into a meaningful contrast without making the two scenes one event.
findings.reader_payoff: The earlier laboring phrase is heard again when the mountain is set upright, making the focus's purposeful firmness sharpen the sense of human exhaustion.
findings.containment: The ordinary mountain emplacement remains the floor. The contrast is a contextual lexical recurrence, not a claim that mountains experience fatigue, that human labor caused their erection, or that the two scenes are morally adjudicated into one winner.

epistemic.reason: The trusted cross-run finding, exact 88:3 connection, reader activation, and retrospective echo agree on the recurrence; the contrastive moral effect remains an inference.

findings.title: An upright mountain as counter-posture to exhausted faces
findings.claim: The focus mountain's thick bodily-build and upright-setting carriers form a monumental counter-posture to the lowered faces, purposeful labor, and explicit fatigue supplied by 88:2-3.
findings.mechanism: The exact HFT trace joins the focus mountain's B003 thick-build record and B001 upright record to the face-as-self, lowering, work, and B004 fatigue records in 88:2-3; their contact changes neutral erection into a load-bearing posture contrasted with exhausted human bodies.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus passive result becomes bodily and positional: an upright mass stands where the earlier human posture bends under work and fatigue.
findings.containment: The focus still says that mountains were set upright. The load-bearing and counter-posture relation is attributed contextual inference; unresolved context branches carry no invented gloss or facet, and no physical force or moral causality beyond the supplied posture contrast is claimed.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record has exact Arabic anchors, word indices, roots, roles, changed reading, and a medium confidence trace, but its context lexicon joins are legacy-unbound and remain attributed.

findings.title: Installed mountains as watershed and basin edges
findings.claim: The focus mountain mass and boundary-stone installation can be read as terrain that partitions catchments and directs water between the adverse spring and the flowing spring supplied in the wider trace.
findings.mechanism: The focus branches supply solid terrain and boundary installation; the exact context trace supplies drinking, a following-track image, opposed springs, and continuous flow, so the focus emplacement becomes a possible watershed and basin-edge relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The mountain observation opens a working landscape: where water gathers, divides, and runs becomes newly perceptible through the installed form.
findings.containment: The plain reading remains the directed question about how mountains were set. HFT explicitly states that watershed causality is inferred and that the springs may remain independent examples; unresolved context branches have no invented gloss or facet. Wider water-system connections corroborate the possibility but do not supply target morphology.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has exact anchor ayahs, source word indices, roles, changed reading, and medium confidence, while the hydraulic causality is explicitly an attributed inference.

findings.claim: The focus mountain's firm-weave and upright-installation carriers meet the ordered furnishings, canopy, raised sky, and surfaced earth so the mountains can be read as upright ribs or tensioning fixtures in a furnished cosmic interior.
findings.mechanism: The exact HFT trace places the focus carriers inside a sequence of raised rests, placed vessels, aligned cushions, spread carpets, raised sky, and surfaced earth; their shared passive placement grammar joins mountain solidity and erection to a habitable textile-like arrangement.
findings.reader_payoff: The mountains acquire an architectural relation to the surrounding scene: they are not isolated rocks but upright members within a world that appears arranged and furnished.
findings.containment: The focus remains the ordinary question of mountain emplacement. The interior and textile image is explicitly an attributed inference, with the live alternative that the passives are a rhetorical catalogue rather than one literal enclosure; unresolved context branches have no invented lexical glosses.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace supplies exact context coordinates, roles, before/after reading, and medium confidence, but its system-level interior causality is explicitly inferential.

findings.title: The installed mountain as anti-veiling evidence
findings.claim: The mountain's visible mass and deliberate upright installation can function as exposed counter-evidence within a wider axis of covering, beacon-like visibility, turning away, and concealed truth.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers are returned to by exact context traces for comprehensive covering, covering of understanding, visible heat or beacon, bodily turning, and concealment of truth; the contact changes failure to see from absent access into an active veiling or redirected-attention possibility.
findings.reader_payoff: The question about mountain installation becomes an examination of evidence that is made conspicuous and therefore difficult to hide except by turning away or covering understanding.
findings.containment: The ordinary mountain observation remains intact. The anti-veiling function is a legacy HFT inference, and the packet keeps a live alternative in which the surrounding material is ethical and eschatological without assigning mountains a specific optical role; unresolved branches remain attributed.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace gives exact context anchors, roles, changed reading, and medium confidence, but the exposure-versus-veiling operation is explicitly inferred.

It is retained as an exploratory visual-acoustic analogy only; no direct translation of the focus into music is claimed, and unresolved context branches have no invented gloss or facet.

epistemic.reason: The HFT outlier has exact anchor coordinates, a registered focus song facet, a changed reading, and an explicit containment note, but its acoustic-to-visual transfer is exploratory.
